system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Deathsinger abilities, and you must have died and been remade at least once

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You become what Mother always wanted you to be.

As an Action, you may complete your remaking and take on a dreadful new form of your choosing.

  • Choose 2 Attributes from Body, Mind, and Soul. The chosen Attributes increase by +2.

  • Your Unarmed attacks are no longer considered Ineffective, the Range of your Melee attacks increases by +1, and all your Speeds increase by +5.

  • You cannot become Contaminated, you do not need to breathe, and you are immune to disease and poison.

  • Once per turn, when a creature dies within 10 spaces of you, you may integrate its useful parts as a Free Action to reduce your Wounds by 1, or to restore Stamina equal to your Body.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, the Dead Mother's children and those who care for them will recognize you as one of her own and afford you special respect.
